# Latiyal Infotech

> > Latiyal Infotech provides Cricket APIs and Cricket Live Line APIs for real-time sports data, live scores, and match updates for cricket applications and platforms.

Latiyal Infotech specializes in cricket data solutions, offering comprehensive APIs for live cricket scores, IPL data, and ball-by-ball updates. The platform serves developers building cricket apps with RESTful APIs delivering real-time match data, scorecards, and statistics across formats including JSON.
